featured_reviews.name: Dipankar Meshram
featured_reviews.review_text:
The hospital is located on the main road, which makes it easy to find. However, parking is a challenge as there is limited space available for both 2-wheelers and 4-wheelers.

The hospital premises are clean and well-maintained. The doctor I consulted was good and professional. One thing I really liked was their appointment system—they call beforehand to confirm whether you’ll be coming, which helps in better management.

The lift is quite small and can accommodate only around 4 people at a time, so during rush hours, there might be a wait. The hospital does get crowded, but overall, it is managed quite efficiently.

Overall, it was a decent experience, and one can consider visiting here for consultation.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall facility needs a massive upgrade in terms of consistent hygiene, ventilation Aircon perpetually doesn't cool enough and the pharmacy is dusty  and not cool at all which is crucial for storage of medical supplies .and very poorly stocked and lack basic pharmacy knowledge .
Nurses are lackadaisical at best and some are absolutely rude entitled and lack servitude et have a very poor bedside manner.

Prajakta Nurse is a rare gem and Joyce in charge of floors is sweet and helpful.

The ward rooms are subpar with Zero upkeep for the premium they charge when compared to Nanavati or Hinduja. Hygiene is non existent we had blood stains and overall a.messy room alotted with no Aircon and had to switch 3 rooms before having one cleant for us inspite of giving advance  intimation. The man at the accounts dept in the night was extremely rude and behaved badly with the other folks present there also I can't remember his name.

Admin staff is kind especially Ms Farida at reception is very helpful.

Management should consider hiring nurses that actually believes in servitude and genuinely care their patients and grasp that people aren't there on a picnic and be more considerate. Kindly shape up instead of resting on past laurels.

featured_reviews.name: Cherish Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are some people in life whom you can never thank enough, and for us, Dr. Nand Kishor Kabra and the entire NICU team at Surya Hospital will always be among them.

As parents of an extremely premature baby born at just 28 weeks and weighing barely 1 kg, we entered the NICU with fear, uncertainty, and shattered hearts. Those days were the most emotionally difficult days of our lives. But from the very beginning, Dr. Kabra gave us something priceless — hope.

His calmness, knowledge, confidence, and years of expertise in neonatology made us feel that our tiny baby was in the safest hands possible. Every decision was explained with patience, every setback was handled with immense care, and every tiny milestone was celebrated with us. What truly sets Dr. Kabra apart is not just his brilliance as a neonatologist, but the compassion and humanity with which he treats both babies and parents.

Today, seeing our little Ashriel growing, smiling, vocalizing, and filling our home with life feels nothing short of a miracle, and we know a huge part of that miracle belongs to Dr. Kabra and the wonderful NICU team at Surya Hospital.

We will forever remain grateful to Surya Hospital for giving our tiny fighter the best possible start to life. Thank you for your dedication, your kindness, and for standing beside families during their most vulnerable moments. You don’t just treat babies — you save dreams, families, and futures.

Forever grateful.
